Card Q&A.q: P-194 [Aegiomon] with this card in its digivolution cards performs a security check, and when it would be deleted after losing a battle against a Security Digimon,  prevents the deletion. At such times, can I activate this card's inherited effect and digivolve P-194 [Aegiomon] into a Digimon card with the [Shaman] trait?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a [Shaman] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
